station_selection: Three geographically distinct airports, fixed before candidate forecast scores; not selected for model performance.
history_selection: Seven days chosen for a local correction pilot after observation-only coverage audit, before development or test forecast scores.
bias_correction: Fixed mean observed-minus-forecast residual per station on training rows only.
smoke_test: January 29/31 fitting and February 4 prediction were inspected only within this protocol's training period.

timesfm.nwp_covariate: Past 168 hours and future 48 hours of temperature guidance. Past guidance concatenates nonoverlapping 48-hour segments from earlier runs, each initialized six hours before its segment origin; future guidance uses the current origin's run. No future observations or reanalysis covariates.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving blocks of scheduled origin dates; all stations resampled together

limits: Three-station February-May pilot, not an India-wide or full-year benchmark and not a direct comparison with Indus predictions.
ECMWF Cycle 49R1 hindcasts via Open-Meteo, not independently verified archived operational forecasts or native-grid ECMWF values.
Forecast publication and observation receipt times are unverified. The six-hour run-age convention and observations through origin are retrospective availability assumptions.
The test period is unseen by this project's temperature comparison, not proven absent from TimesFM pretraining or all upstream model development.
Station temperature is often rounded; sensor height and station/grid representativeness remain unverified.
Eligibility rules may select a nonrepresentative sample. All rejected and failed origins must be reported.
One month of testing gives limited seasonal and temporal coverage; block-bootstrap intervals are exploratory.
A pilot pass is evidence only for this retrospective station task, not proof of operational ECMWF or Pravah superiority.
